meta_desc: QuickLinker is a Chrome extension that detects key identifiers on any page, searches multiple sites at once, and shows you which links actually exist.
hero_tagline: Detects the key identifier on any page, searches every site you care about at once, and tells you which links actually exist.
hero_note: No account needed. Everything stays in your browser.
feat_sub: Copy, switch tabs, paste, search — all of it collapsed into a single click.
feat_detect_desc: Pulls codes, IDs, and reference numbers straight off the page. No copying and pasting.
feat_multi_desc: Queries several sites at once and flags in real time whether each link actually exists.
feat_context_desc: Select any text on screen and launch a search straight from the right-click menu.
feat_custom_desc: Define your own sites, URL templates, and scan modes to match how you actually work.
feat_privacy_desc: Settings stay on your machine, nothing is uploaded, and the source is open to review.
feat_speed_desc: Built on Manifest V3 with a minimal background footprint, so browsing stays fast.
how_sub: It works the moment you install it. No setup required.
step_1_desc: Open a supported site and QuickLinker finds the key identifier, then shows a floating button.
step_2_desc: Click to reveal every searchable site and see each link's availability checked live.
step_3_desc: Pick a site to go straight to the results. Duplicate tabs are merged automatically.
case_sub: If your work means looking up the same term across several sites, this is for you.
case_dev_desc: Chase the same error message or issue across GitHub, Stack Overflow, and vendor docs.
case_shop_desc: Check one product across every store at once and see where it's in stock and cheapest.
case_research_desc: Sweep one query across multiple academic databases without retyping it site by site.
case_media_desc: Search videos, music, or books across platforms and confirm they exist before clicking.
cta_sub: Thirty seconds to install. Thirty seconds saved on every search after that.
cta_check_3: Start using it — no setup needed
